_comment: Connector that calls the agent server's /invoke endpoint, targeting the dsl_generator agent. Register with POST /_plugins/_ml/connectors/_create; the returned connector_id is referenced by the FLOW agent in 02_flow_agent.json.
name: Agentic Search Remote DSL Connector
description: Calls the agent server's /invoke endpoint (dsl_generator agent) to translate a natural-language query into OpenSearch DSL.
_comment_parameters: parameters supply defaults substituted into the action below as ${parameters.*}. Set endpoint to the agent server's host.
_comment_credential: Credential values are encrypted at rest on connector creation and referenced as ${credential.*}. Security-sensitive headers such as Authorization reject ${parameters.*} placeholders, so the token must come from credential.

actions._comment_action: action_type 'predict' is selected by the FLOW agent's tool via connector_action (see 02_flow_agent.json); if that parameter is omitted, the ConnectorTool path defaults to the 'execute' action instead.
actions._comment_request_body: query is the NLQ; index_name rides in the generic 'context' object. Both are filled from the agent's runtime parameters at call time. agent selects the dsl_generator; response_format=inference_results makes /invoke return the envelope the passthrough below expects.
actions._comment_post_process: connector.post_process.mlcommons.passthrough reads the 'result' field from each inference output into ModelTensor.result, which is the field neural-search reads. Without it, the response is wrapped into dataAsMap instead.
